title: Judge spans that split on apostrophes in contractions
description:
## Intent

Hook-turn judge finding started at the `s` in `Magnanti's` (`before` was `sandwich.

Magnanti'`). `_index_is_word_boundary` treats `'` as a boundary because it is not `isalnum`, so mid-contraction cuts pass the LIM-906fc9 filter. Apply would have emitted `Magnanti'` plus a new sentence.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Apostrophe is not a word boundary
  Scenario: Span starting after an apostrophe in a contraction is dropped
    Given draft text containing Magnanti's door
    And a judge span whose start index is the s after the apostrophe
    When the judge lane maps findings
    Then that span is not emitted
```

## Out of scope

Published-file apply. Options retry (LIM-f634c3).

comments.author: 8458c498-f041-7092-e4e3-6418236765a7
comments.text:
Grok plan. Composer implements. Worktree `/tmp/limatus-LIM-ce41d9-apostrophe` branch `cursor/feature/LIM-ce41d9-apostrophe` off origin/main.

Treat ASCII apostrophe and U+2019 as word characters in `_index_is_word_boundary` so a span starting at the `s` in `Magnanti's` is dropped. Unittest with that draft. No `project/` in the PR. Do not change options retry (LIM-f634c3).
